featured_reviews.review_text:

The admin team, especially Sheetal and Sushma, were always smiling and super helpful with all my requests—true superstars at the front desk. A special mention to Tayzun, who helped me set up my membership for 4 weeks, making the process seamless and welcoming.
The coaches—Ritika, Maahir, and Sherlock—were consistently full of energy, motivating me to push myself and achieve new personal bests.
Thanks to the entire team, I was able to complete nine awesome workouts while in the city. I look forward to seeing you all again in December!

If you’re looking for a gym that offers challenging and fun group workouts, this is the place to be!

featured_reviews.name: Anav Jhunjhunwala
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolute respect for Ravi Sir. He knows his stuff inside out, backs everything with scientific evidence, and keeps me constantly motivated. featured_reviews.name: Atharv Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have had the privilege of training at Sprinters Sports Club, and I must say it has been nothing short of extraordinary. From the moment I stepped onto the track, I was welcomed by a highly professional and supportive environment that fosters both athletic growth and mental fortitude.

The coaching staff at Sprinters Sports Club is second to none. Dr. Ravindra Kumar Walmiki, the head coach, is not only incredibly knowledgeable but also certified and highly experienced. His approach to training is both scientific and functional, ensuring every session is tailored to maximize performance. Unlike traditional coaches who often encourage running blindly, Dr. Walmiki’s methods are rooted in science and focus on building functional strength and technique. He integrates cutting-edge training principles, ensuring athletes train smartly, not just hard. His deep understanding of biomechanics and sprinting physiology truly sets him apart, making workouts not just effective but also purposeful.

The facilities are world-class, with a well-maintained synthetic track, state-of-the-art training equipment, and all the necessary amenities to provide an ideal setting for both training and recovery. The positive energy among fellow athletes creates a competitive yet supportive atmosphere that pushes everyone to bring their best every day.

I can confidently say that Sprinters Sports Club is a place where athletes are shaped into champions, thanks in large part to the guidance of Dr. Ravindra Kumar Walmiki. I highly recommend this club to anyone looking to improve their sprinting performance, from beginners to elite sprinters.

A top-tier training ground for future stars!

featured_reviews.name: Taronish Irani
featured_reviews.review_text: Sprinters Sports Club is an institution that combines scientific research and applies valuable knowledge to athletics which not only makes the athletes better in their performance but provides us with a great and joyful learning experience. I was always a long distance runner, but after I joined this club I realized that there is so much more to just running in order for an athlete to reach their peak potential. The various drills and exercises along with running have benefited me immensely. Grateful to my great Guru, Ravi sir for always believing in me and making sure I am at my best performance in each and every training session.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a member of the Gym since five years.
The main reason I joined the gym is because they believe in giving attention and respect to every member. I have used other gyms in the past. The most disturbing thing about other gyms is that they give you attention only if you hire personal trainers.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I was in Mumbai last week and visited Galaxy Sports Shop in Metro, Dhabi Talao, to buy two cricket bats—one for myself and a harrow-size bat for my 13-year-old son. The shop owner, Harshad, was extremely helpful and very knowledgeable. With the rising prices of English willow bats, he guided us to the best options that were excellent in quality and still within our budget.

He was kind enough to machine-knock both bats for us at no extra cost, which was really appreciated. The shop is fully stocked with a wide range of sports equipment and accessories—cricket, football, tennis, badminton, paddle sports, and more.

I would highly recommend Galaxy Sports Shop for all your sporting needs in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: swapnil sherlekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought a cricket kit from Galaxy Sport & Fitness around 2 years ago for my son Samarth, and it has been one of the best decisions for his cricket journey. The kit was from BDM, and the quality has been outstanding.

Since then, Samarth has been practicing regularly and playing matches with the same kit. Even after continuous use, the performance and durability are still excellent. This kit has played an important role in supporting his growth and passion for cricket.

We are very thankful to this shop for providing such high-quality equipment.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for genuine and top-quality cricket gear!
